 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rahul Bharti, Judge.

All the writ petitioners claim themselves to be drawing their cause of action in filing of this writ petition by reference to their common ancestor to lay claim with respect to the land in reference and thereby seeking the reliefs as prayed for in the writ petition which are as under:
"1. By issuance of writ, order or direction one in the nature of mandamus, the respondents be commanded to strictly adhere to the provision of law contained under Land Acquisition Act and Right to Fair Compensation, Transparency in Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013 before undertaking process of construction of sports facility on the landed property of the petitioners comprising of land measuring 19 kanals 19 marlas falling under Survey No. 227 (new) situated at Shivpora Srinagar Kashmir and pay adequate amount of compensation at prevailing market rate unto the petitioners Javeed Hussain Wani & Ors vs Union Territory Of J&K And Ors on 2 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/175193693/
1 2.

sentences.text:
By issuance of writ, order or direction one in the nature of mandamus, the respondents be commanded not to construct any kind of sport facility on the proprietary land of the petitioners without first resorting to initiation of acquisition proceedings under Land Acquisition Act and Right to Fair Compensation,
Transparency in Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act 2013.
3.

sentences.text: By issuance of writ, order or direction one in the nature of mandamus, the respondents be commanded to take decision on the representation filed by the petitioners with regard to seeking rectification of the entries made in the revenue records.

4. The respondents be saddled with the costs of litigation amounting to Rs.
2,00,000/-
5.
Any other relief, order or direction which this Hon'ble Court may deem fit and proper under the circumstances of the case may also be passed in favour of the petitioners and against the respondents."

02. Only with respect to relief No. 3, this writ petition is being entertained for the reason being that some of the petitioners' representation is pending consideration before a Committee constituted under Government Order No. 322-JK/GAD of 2022 dated 25.03.2022 which has been set up to carry out the revenue record correction at the instance of the aggrieved parties and by that reference some of the petitioners submit that their grievance is also pending disposal without any outcome.
Financial Commissioner (Revenue), J&K who is said to be the head of the committee constituted under the Government Order No. 322-JK/GAD of 2022 dated 25.03.2022.
04.

Petitioner to furnish registered postal cover within a period of seven days, whereupon the Registrar Judicial Srinagar to issue notice to the respondent No. 2.
05.

(RAHUL BHARTI) JUDGE SRINAGAR:
02.09.2025 "HAMID"
